topBarTip: Generate or refresh the document TOC
dialogNoHeadings: This document has no headings, so a TOC cannot be generated.
dialogHint: Configure auto-update, delay, TOC title, and heading depth in Settings → Plugins → Document TOC.
busy: Generating the table of contents, please wait
noDocument: No active document. Open a document and try again
noHeadings: This document has no headings; nothing was generated
failed: Failed to generate the table of contents
markFailed: The TOC was inserted but could not be verified. Please try again
settingAutoUpdateDesc: Refresh an existing TOC after you stop typing. It never creates a TOC automatically.
settingDebounceDesc: Between 1 and 10 seconds; applies only when auto-update is enabled.
settingTitleDesc: Text shown on the first line. Leave empty to use the localized default.
settingMaxLevelDesc: Only collect headings up to this level, e.g. H1–H3 ignores h4–h6.
